e.title: Databricks Actuarial Architecture
e.summary: Databricks 精算建模参考架构：湖仓上的精算模型工程化蓝图
e.body: Databricks Actuarial Modeling Reference Architecture 是 Databricks 官方发布的精算建模参考架构：在 Lakehouse 上做精算建模（数据/特征/建模/部署的蓝图）——云计算厂商给出的精算工程化方案。对 RIAA：精算建模的云上工程蓝图——与 [[aws-insurancelake-etl]]（AWS 保险数据湖）对照两大云厂商路线；理解「精算模型上云」的现代工程范式（湖仓 + MLflow + 治理）；配合 [[insurance-mlops]]（MLOps 流程）做生产化；精算 IT/数据平台岗位的行业蓝图。
e.verified_note: 文档核实：Databricks 官网确认（精算建模参考架构），未实测部署
e.summary_en: Databricks actuarial-modelling reference architecture: an engineering blueprint for actuarial models on the lakehouse
e.summary_hk: Databricks 精算建模參考架構：湖倉上的精算模型工程化藍圖
e.body_en: The Databricks Actuarial Modeling Reference Architecture is Databricks' official reference architecture for actuarial modelling: an engineering blueprint (data/features/modelling/deployment) for actuarial models on the Lakehouse. For RIAA: a cloud engineering blueprint for actuarial modelling — contrasting the [[aws-insurancelake-etl]] (AWS insurance data lake) across the two cloud-vendor routes; understand the modern engineering paradigm of 'actuarial models in the cloud' (lakehouse + MLflow + governance); with [[insurance-mlops]] (MLOps processes) it supports productionisation; an industry blueprint for actuarial-IT/data-platform roles.
e.body_hk: Databricks Actuarial Modeling Reference Architecture 是 Databricks 官方發佈的精算建模參考架構：在 Lakehouse 上做精算建模（數據/特徵/建模/部署的藍圖）——雲計算廠商給出的精算工程化方案。對 RIAA：精算建模的雲上工程藍圖——與 [[aws-insurancelake-etl]]（AWS 保險數據湖）對照兩大雲廠商路線；理解「精算模型上雲」的現代工程範式（湖倉 + MLflow + 治理）；配合 [[insurance-mlops]]（MLOps 流程）做生產化；精算 IT/數據平台崗位的行業藍圖。
